notes.title: Exciting Updates: New Look, New Features, Playable Demo, and More!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, [i]Emerald Caravan[/i] fans! 🌟[/b]

We’re so excited to share some amazing updates with you! If you've visited the game’s Steam page recently, you might have noticed that the game’s Steam page is looking a bit different now - new screenshots and a brand-new trailer are up! 🎥 Since we took over Emerald Caravan from Space Fox, we've been working tirelessly to elevate [i]Emerald Caravan[/i] to a whole new level. While this is just the beginning, we believe the improvements are already shining through, giving you a much better visual experience! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777272/d51b683430fd37feb348dfe4e171a186b9f1b98c.gif[/img]

But, it’s not just about graphics! From day one, we set out to improve every little detail of the game, and that includes giving our main character a fresh new look. 🐆 Say hello to our adorable leopardess! We want [i]Emerald Caravan[/i] to be as immersive and fun as possible, and we think having a unique and charming main character helps bring the world to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777272/6a7f83b87c9b2d7bd20af43d2c1e8d9b97dffdac.gif[/img]

Of course, a good game isn’t just about visuals or characters - no way! We know that gameplay is what really matters, and over the past few months, we’ve been working hard to take it up a notch. ⚔️ We’ve added new weapons, improved enemy AI, and included cool new features. Now, you can even grow your own plants or take care of farm animals! 🐓🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777272/09e65fd9f8747b9bd6c977eb3e22c35f17ac9593.gif[/img]

This is just the beginning of making [i]Emerald Caravan[/i] truly special. In the months ahead, we’ll be adding more content, polishing every aspect of the game, and refining the story. 📖

We want YOU to be part of this journey! 💬 Your feedback means everything to us, and we’d love to hear your thoughts on the changes and the game in general. [b]That’s why we’re thrilled to announce that a playable demo will be available on Steam this month! [/b]🎮 You’ll get to explore a few locations and try out all the core elements of the game. We can’t wait to hear what you think!

And if you haven’t done so already, [b]don’t forget to wishlist [i]Emerald Caravan[/i]![/b] Your support means the world to us! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2689710

notes.title: Emerald Caravan officially announced!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777272/8d36de8841ee2e7b7202802b6f5632e42c002ab0.png[/img]

Hello Guys!

We've got some amazing news to share! We're more than happy to finally announce our next title, [i][b]Emerald Caravan[/b][/i]!

[h2]What's Emerald Caravan about?[/h2]

[i][b]Emerald Caravan[/b][/i] is a shop managment game with RPG and rogue-lite elements. You'll be able to travel across the colorful land, where magic and technology slowly combine into one! Explore dungeons, take care of your shop and sell good you've found and crafted. But there's more to that!

[h2]There's more to that![/h2]

Your family business collapsed and you'll need to discover what's the reason behind its fall. Also, there are many secrets hidden in the dungeons. What's more, there are crystals that are used as a magic fuel to power up some of the machines. How excatly do they work - that's a mystery that none knows! Is it possible that all of that elements are somehow linked to each other?

[h3]We will share more details regarding Emerald Caravan soon! [/h3]

It would be awesome if you could follow and support our work! We can't wait to see you the development process of our newest title! Meanwhile, please, see the announcement trailer and lett us know your thoughts in the comments!

[previewyoutube=ceKuOWqAmtA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2689710/Emerald_Caravan/
